# ui::CommandValues

Header: `winui/ui/Command.hpp`.

What a [Command](command.md)'s fields hold right now ([Command::current()](command.md#current)). A bound field holds its latest value, a plain field its fixed value.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `std::string` |  | The command's text. |
| `icon` | `IconSource` |  | The command's icon. |
| `shortcut` | `KeyCombo` |  | The command's shortcut. |
| `description` | `std::string` |  | The command's description. |
| `enabled` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the command may run. |
